title: Candi Solar and Pentagreen to Fund 400 MW Solar-Plus-Storage Projects
summary: Clean energy company Candi Solar has announced a $50 million partnership with Pentagreen Capital to finance 400 MW of solar and battery energy storage projects in India. The partnership aims to expand access to clean energy for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It will also help Candi Solar achieve its target to more than double its total capacity to over 1 GW over the next 24 months.
